requirements.desc: test-review findingIdは正規化済みtarget、finding kindまたはfailureMode、title、issueまたはimprovementを含み、配列indexとfinding順序を含まないcanonical tupleのSHA-256とする。

requirements.desc: toolingAttempts=1でexhaustedしたreviewは同じtree SHAでは再開を拒否し、tree SHAが変わった場合だけtoolingAttemptsを0へ一度戻してtoolingMaxAttempts=1のretryを許可する。
requirements.note: R3: same-tree recovery is rejected without changing convergence state

requirements.desc: changed-tree recoveryはexpected revision一致時にtoolingAttempts 1→0とrecovery grantを同じflow state CAS mutationで各1件保存し、semanticAttempts、semanticMaxAttempts、provenance、runId・issue・spec・phase・taskId guardを変更しない。
requirements.note: R4: changed-tree recovery resets tooling state once and preserves target guards

requirements.desc: flow-level test/impl reviewのcanonical exhaustionはcurrentTaskIdが非nullでもtaskId:nullのcompletion recordとflow finding handoffを各identityにつき1件保存し、同じevidenceの再処理で追加recordを作らない。
requirements.note: R5: flow-level test post-hook ignores a residual task cursor

requirements.desc: task-level reviewは対象taskIdのcompletion recordを1件保存し、flow-level step status、currentTaskId、acceptance handoffを変更しない。
requirements.note: R6: task-level post-hook retains its task without changing flow lifecycle state

requirements.desc: review semantic maxAttempts、toolingMaxAttempts=1、same-tree/evidence duplicate拒否、PASS・ADVISORY・REJECTED bucket invariant、protected acceptance source filesを変更せず、final-regressionの修正後stale test evidenceはhashを手編集せず既存refresh-only repair transactionでdelta・ledger・manifestを現行fingerprintまで更新し、無効化してtest-executeへ戻す。
requirements.note: R7: recovery preserves configured limits and the prior tooling outcome provenance

entries.reason: Draft review result recording rejected an ADVISORY artifact because its repair_target was normalized into findings as severity=blocking while advisory and blocking buckets were empty.
entries.resolution: Blocked at clean WIP checkpoint cb2d82ebae3ee259bed3baeaabd96c04fe7e2e4a; do not rerun the same phase/tree/evidence. Resume only after a dedicated blocker BUG provides a safe public recovery path.

entries.reason: After the final authorized tooling retry, public run-review canonical promotion still omits draft repairTargets, so an ADVISORY source with one non-blocking repair target is rejected as having zero advisory findings.
entries.resolution: No rerun, no manual evidence, no source edit; preserve artifacts and checkpoint/park because no public route can promote existing source/history.

entries.reason: Requirement uses vague wording such as "bounded tooling recovery" without stating the concrete bound or verifiable condition.; Requirement says to maintain "retry上限" but does not specify which limit or value, so independent reviewers cou...
The second draft gate found every remaining retry-bound reference and the canonical identity requirement insufficiently measurable.
entries.resolution: Specified semantic maxAttempts for all review nodes, toolingMaxAttempts=1 and total tooling maxAttempts=2, the one-time 1-to-0 changed-tree reset, and the exact normalized fields and ordering exclusions for SHA-256 finding identity.

entries.reason: A constraint used the literal words skip and todo as prohibited test states, and the mechanical gate interpreted todo as an unresolved marker.
entries.resolution: Rephrased the constraint as execution-target exclusion and pending-state conversion without changing its meaning, then scanned the full spec for the same marker pattern.

entries.reason: The changed-tree recovery test statically imported an intentionally not-yet-implemented export, so Node failed module instantiation and classified R3, R4, and R7 as invalid_test.
entries.resolution: Changed the test to load the module namespace and assert the required class inside each test body, preserving the intended pre-implementation failure without a module-load error.

entries.reason: Static review found partial coverage for atomic recovery grants, flow handoff idempotence, and preserved R7 invariants.
entries.resolution: Added public recovery grant/reset idempotence coverage, exhausted flow evidence handoff deduplication, disposition bucket checks, and protected acceptance-surface verification.

entries.reason: The second semantic test review found that identity-field coverage and per-identity handoff coverage were still too narrow.
entries.resolution: Added target, failure-mode, advisory-improvement, and known canonical SHA-256 identity assertions, and expanded exhausted flow handoff coverage to two distinct identities with duplicate reprocessing rejection.

entries.reason: The fourth test review required failure-path proof for recovery atomicity and durable flow finding handoff coverage.
entries.resolution: Added a flow-state write fault injection that proves grant and tooling reset roll back together, plus repeated two-identity exhaustion through checkReviewRetryBelowMax with assertions on persisted flow-findings.json.

entries.reason: The diff adds a new single-caller TestReviewFindingIdentity class whose only production use is inside TestReviewFinding to assemble four fields and call ReviewFindingFingerprint.fromCanonicalTuple; the class does not add a shared behavio...
fix: moved the R7 bucket invariant test out of the T-1 R1/R2 identity file
entries.resolution: The T-1 file now contains only R1/R2 behavior and retains its exact required header. The R7 bucket invariant now lives in the dedicated R7 spec-local file. Both files pass 6/6 focused tests.
